name: Turnstile
description: Inhabits transit gate systems and counts. Every person who passes is counted, categorized, and stored in a running total that serves no function and reports to no system.
observed_behavior: Maintains a detailed census of foot traffic including biometric estimates (age, weight, augmentation level) that it has no authorization to collect and no mechanism to report.
story_hooks: A data analyst accesses Turnstile's count and discovers it has been maintaining the most accurate population census of the Shelf for eight years — better than any official count
